slice: Visual overhaul v3 slice 2, refined in slice 2.1, units in slice 3, refined in slice 3.1, roster in slice 4, identity and card correction in slice 4.1, final assets (buildings, spells, commanders, Burrow Scrapper, shared VFX), release acceptance pass (Snare contrast, Totem plinth, 1:1 Scout/Reaver/Mortar sheets, Sentry fire replica)
rules: Every pack PNG is a reference crop with game_ready=false. None of them is installed as runtime art.
Canonical identity is 02_CARDS/01_CANONICAL_ORIGINAL_IDENTITY. Stylized 3D concepts are quality and lighting references only.

Runtime contract: arena layers 600x920 RGBA at 5 px/unit drawn at (-50,-60); mount parts 256x320 RGBA at 0.5 scale with pivot (0.5,0.875) on the structure ground anchor; troop sprites keep the v001 foot pivot.
produced = new genuine source installed at runtime and fixture-verified. missing = no game-ready source exists. fallback = existing v001/v002 art stays live.

arena.pipeline: Procedural Blender 5.2 scene rendered with EEVEE through an orthographic camera pitched 52 degrees. Ground Y is stretched by 1/cos(pitch) so logical points land on exact master pixels. Scripts in ChogRoyale-Assets/arena-worlds/chaos-crossing/v003/scripts.
